title: Competition among weak C–H⋯O/S/H interactions in the crystal structure of {(C2H5O)2P(S)}2N2C4H8 bis(thiophosphoramide): experimental/computational studies
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22671-22681
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01306B, Paper

Maliheh Khorramaki, Mehrdad Pourayoubi, Vahidreza Darugar, Mohammad Vakili, Marek Nečas, Mahmood Akbari, Malik Maaza
Competition among the weak C–H⋯O/S/H interactions in the crystal structure of {(C2H5O)2P(S)}2N2C4H8 bis(thiophosphoramide) is studied. The energies of these non-covalent interactions are evaluated using chemical calculations.
